about: You are the imprisoned dictator. People of your country come visit. Survive as long as you can.
- From the testimonies of your visitors, discover the pillars of dictatorship.
- Explore how different layers of society suffer from authoritarianism and kleptocracy.

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
